sections.description:
StoreEngine — The Complete WordPress eCommerce Plugin to Build, Sell, and Run Your Entire Store

StoreEngine is a complete WordPress ecommerce plugin and store management platform — a fast, modern, lightweight market leader alternative that lets you sell digital products, physical products, subscriptions, memberships, courses, services, and licenses from a single Gutenberg-native core.

But StoreEngine is no longer just an online store plugin. It now runs your entire commerce operation: a built-in POS terminal, inventory and multi-location stock control, suppliers and purchase orders, cost and profit tracking, returns (RMA), courier management, and a full multi-vendor marketplace — all without stacking 5+ premium plugins or paying for add-ons.

Whether you sell online, in person, or both, StoreEngine gives you everything to start, manage, and scale your store inside WordPress — securely, smoothly, and without slowing your site down.

Check our overview video of StoreEngine 👇

StoreEngine | Docs | Video Tutorials | Community | Public Roadmap

🎯 Built for store owners who want everything in one place

  • Agencies & freelancers — ship a complete store for any client without stacking plugins
  • Digital creators — sell ebooks, software, templates, and assets with secure file delivery and license keys
  • Physical & retail sellers — manage inventory, POS, shipping, suppliers, and returns from one dashboard
  • Subscription & membership businesses — recurring billing, trials, upgrades, and gated access, natively
  • Course creators — sell online courses through native Academy LMS integration
  • Service providers — sell packages, appointments, and one-time services with flexible checkout
  • Marketplace builders — launch a multi-vendor store with vendor dashboards and commissions

🛒 Sell Anything — Digital, Physical, Subscriptions & More

StoreEngine handles every product type from one ecommerce dashboard — no separate plugins, no extra add-on costs.

  • Sell digital products — secure, signed download URLs with instant delivery for software, ebooks, music, and design assets
  • Physical product selling — SKU tracking, variants (size, color, material), and stock status built in
  • Subscription products — flexible billing cycles with trials, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations
  • Memberships & access control — gate content, courses, and communities with one-time or recurring access
  • Sell online courses — native Academy LMS integration for course checkout, enrollments, and bundles
  • License management — automate license creation, activation, renewals, and usage tracking
  • Product bundles — group products, courses, or memberships into a single high-value offer
  • Installment plans — let customers pay high-ticket items in scheduled payments to reduce hesitation
  • Catalog mode — display products without checkout, perfect for wholesalers and previews

🏬 Run Your Whole Store — POS, Inventory & Operations

This is where StoreEngine goes beyond a typical WordPress ecommerce plugin into a full retail and store management system.

  • POS terminal — fast in-person checkout with online/offline inventory sync; sell in-store and online from one system
  • Inventory management — stock tracking, quantity adjustments, low-stock alerts, and movement monitoring
  • Multi-location inventory — manage stock across warehouses and stores with transfers and availability tracking
  • Suppliers & purchase orders — create POs, track incoming stock, and streamline restocking
  • Cost & profit tracking — monitor product costs, margins, and store profitability for smarter pricing
  • Return / RMA system — structured returns, refund requests, and approval workflows
  • Couriers management — manage delivery couriers, fulfillment, and order tracking centrally
  • Shipping module — multiple zones, flat-rate pricing, and real-time carrier integrations
  • SKU & barcode generator — auto-generate SKUs and barcode labels with logo and store-name toggles

💳 Payments & Checkout That Convert

  • Stripe & PayPal out of the box — PCI-DSS compliant card payments, refunds, and subscription billing
  • Razorpay — accept UPI, net banking, wallets, and cards across India
  • Native Stripe subscriptions — webhook-driven renewals with “Pay Next Renewal Now” support
  • Subscriptions + one-time products in the same cart — single checkout, no separate orders
  • Installment & free (zero-total) checkout — flexible payment flows and frictionless giveaways
  • Order pay — recover failed or pending orders without creating a new one
  • Direct checkout URLs — pre-applied products and coupons for funnels and campaigns
  • Multi-currency support — let customers browse and pay in their preferred currency
  • StoreEngine invoice — auto-generate professional invoices customers can download instantly

📈 Built-in Growth & Marketing Tools

Most plugins charge extra for the features that actually grow revenue. StoreEngine includes them natively.

  • Upsell & cross-sell — boost average order value with related offers and post-purchase add-ons
  • Built-in affiliate system — track referrals, manage commissions, and turn customers into promoters
  • Coupons & discounts — flat or percentage offers with expiry dates and usage limits
  • Advanced analytics dashboard — revenue trends, product performance, and conversion data in one place

🤝 Launch a Multi-Vendor Marketplace

Turn your store into a multi-vendor marketplace where vendors register, manage their own products, and sell from a dedicated dashboard — with commission tracking, approvals, and centralized admin control.

🌍 Compliance, SEO & AI — Future-Ready by Default

  • EU VAT & EU compliance — VAT validation, sequential invoice numbers, and a consent log
  • GDPR & privacy compliance — data export, erasure requests, and order anonymization via the WordPress Privacy API
  • Tax management — per-product, per-region tax rules with inclusive or exclusive pricing
  • Built-in SEO addon — dual-mode engine that integrates with Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress, or works standalone, with REST support for headless storefronts
  • AI content generation — native WordPress AI abilities for product copy and SEO meta; runs on your own hosting with no third-party API keys required (opt-in AI add-ons for other features are listed under External services)
  • Brand management — organize and display products by brand for multi-manufacturer stores

🛠️ Developer-Friendly & Admin-First

  • Webhooks — push order, customer, and subscription events to CRMs and automation tools
  • WP-CLI support — manage your store from the command line, including demo-content seeders
  • Admin global search & command palette — jump to any setting instantly with Cmd/Ctrl+K
  • Migration tool — import products, customers, and orders from any eCommerce without breaking your layout
  • CSV import / export — bulk-manage products, customers, and orders
  • Activity & error logger — debug payments and monitor store operations
  • GeoIP & location-based commerce — smarter shipping, currency, and checkout by location
  • Email notifications — branded, customizable transactional emails with no code
  • Setup wizard — configure payments and core settings in minutes

Note: StoreEngine’s eCommerce blocks require the free aBlocks plugin — the modern Gutenberg website builder.

💥 Why StoreEngine Instead of Stacking Plugins

Most WordPress ecommerce setups need five or more plugins — one for subscriptions, one for memberships, one for invoicing, another for POS or inventory — each adding cost, bloat, and conflicts.

StoreEngine is built from the ground up to solve that. Checkout, cart, coupons, product filtering, and login are all native Gutenberg blocks, so you control your entire store flow without code. Business-critical features like subscriptions, memberships, webhooks, invoicing, affiliates, and POS activate with a single click. The result is a lighter, faster, more secure, and future-ready way to run commerce on WordPress.

Get Started With StoreEngine

From your first digital download to a multi-location retail operation, StoreEngine grows with you — one fast plugin instead of a dozen. Install StoreEngine today, run your setup wizard, and start selling in minutes.

Join the thriving StoreEngine community of entrepreneurs, creators, and developers building scalable, secure online stores worldwide.

Stay connected for the latest updates and insights:

External services

StoreEngine can connect to a number of third-party services. Everything in this list is optional, off by default, and only activates when you turn on the corresponding addon or paste in your own URL / credentials. No store data leaves your site until you do.

  • Payment providers — Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, Razorpay, Mollie, Paystack, Square. Enabled per gateway on Settings → Payment methods. Order, customer and payment details are sent to the gateway you choose. See each provider’s privacy policy and terms of service for details.
  • Shipping carriers / couriers — DHL, UPS, FedEx and the regional couriers you enable on Settings → Shipping. Order address and parcel details are sent only to the carriers you turn on.
  • IP geolocation — only when Settings → “Default customer location” is set to a geolocation option. If no local MaxMind database is available, the visitor’s IP address is sent to one of these lookup services to find their country: ipinfo.io (privacy), freeipapi.com (privacy), ipapi.co (privacy), ipwhois.app (privacy). When the site runs on a local or private network, the store’s own public IP is first looked up through ipify, ipecho.net, ident.me or tnedi.me; only the request itself is sent.
  • MaxMind GeoLite2 — when you enter a MaxMind license key for geolocation, the key is validated with MaxMind and the GeoLite2 country database is downloaded from download.maxmind.com and refreshed periodically. Only the license key is sent. Terms, privacy policy.
  • EU VAT number validation — when the EU VAT addon is enabled and a customer enters a VAT number at checkout, the VAT number and its country code are sent to the European Commission’s VIES service (privacy) or, for UK numbers, to HMRC’s VAT check API (privacy).
  • Currency exchange rates — when the Multi-Currency addon is set to update rates automatically, the store’s base currency (and your API key, where the provider needs one) is sent to the provider you pick: Frankfurter (no key), Open Exchange Rates (terms, privacy), ExchangeRate-API (terms) or CurrencyBeacon (terms).
  • CAPTCHA — when the CAPTCHA addon is enabled for a form, the provider’s script is loaded on that form, and the visitor’s CAPTCHA response token and IP address are sent to the provider to verify it: Google reCAPTCHA (terms, privacy), Cloudflare Turnstile (terms, privacy) or hCaptcha (terms, privacy).
  • Invoice PDF fonts — when an admin clicks “Download fonts” in the Invoice addon settings, a font archive (TTF files only, no code) is downloaded from kodezen.com so PDFs can render non-Latin scripts. No site data is sent. Terms, privacy policy.
  • Store digest webhook / Slack — if you paste an https webhook URL or Slack incoming-webhook URL into Settings → Marketing → Store Digest, the digest payload (KPIs, top products, orders needing attention) is POSTed to that URL on each scheduled send. Leave the fields empty and nothing is sent.
  • Store digest AI summary (opt-in) — when “AI insights” is enabled on Settings → Marketing → Store Digest, a short JSON blob of the period’s KPIs, top three products and attention counts is sent to the AI endpoint configured by the AI addon so it can write one summary paragraph. Off by default; turning it off removes the request entirely.
  • Native “AI content generation” uses the built-in WordPress AI abilities on your own hosting; it does not require third-party API keys and does not send data to Kodezen.
  • Update server — StoreEngine Pro and the paid addons check for updates against Kodezen’s update server using the license key you entered. Only the license key, site URL and the plugin / addon versions are sent. The free StoreEngine plugin updates through WordPress.org.

Please consult each service’s privacy policy and terms of service before enabling it. StoreEngine itself does not phone home from the free wordpress.org build without your explicit action.

Credits

StoreEngine’s optional geolocation feature uses GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com.
sections.faq:
Can I run a full eCommerce business with StoreEngine?

Yes. StoreEngine gives you a complete WordPress ecommerce toolkit — products, cart, checkout, payments, coupons, and order management — so you can run a real store out of the box. Advanced operational features extend it into a full store-management platform as you scale.

Is StoreEngine a good WooCommerce alternative?

Yes. StoreEngine is a fast, lightweight WooCommerce alternative that replaces the typical 5+ plugin stack with one native core, and includes a migration tool to import your products, customers, and orders without losing data.

Does StoreEngine support both physical and digital products?

Absolutely. Sell physical goods with inventory, variants, and shipping, or digital products with secure signed downloads and license keys — or both from the same store.

Does StoreEngine have a POS system?

Yes. The built-in POS terminal lets you sell in physical stores with fast in-person checkout and online/offline inventory sync, so your retail and online sales stay in one unified system.

Can I sell subscriptions and memberships?

Yes. StoreEngine supports recurring billing, trials, upgrades, downgrades, and native Stripe subscriptions, plus gated memberships with one-time or recurring access — no third-party plugins needed.

Can I build a multi-vendor marketplace?

Yes. The multi-vendor feature lets vendors register, manage products, and sell from their own dashboard, with commission tracking and centralized admin control.

Can I sell online courses?

Yes. StoreEngine integrates natively with Academy LMS to handle course checkout, enrollments, bundles, and installments from a single dashboard.

What payment methods does StoreEngine support?

Stripe and PayPal work out of the box (PCI-DSS compliant), with Razorpay for UPI, net banking, wallets, and cards in India. Installments, multi-currency, free (zero-total) checkout, and order-pay recovery are all supported.

Can I create product variations like size, color, or material?

Yes. StoreEngine supports product variants with SKU tracking and stock status for each variation.

Does StoreEngine handle EU VAT and GDPR compliance?

Yes. Built-in EU VAT validation, sequential invoice numbers, a consent log, plus GDPR tools for data export, erasure, and order anonymization keep your store compliant.

Will StoreEngine slow down my website?

No. StoreEngine is built on a fast, lightweight, Gutenberg-native core designed to keep your site quick instead of loading multiple heavy plugins.

Can I migrate from WooCommerce to StoreEngine without losing data?

Yes. The built-in migration tool imports your products, customers, and orders accurately, without breaking your existing layout or store setup.

Does StoreEngine work with my existing WordPress theme?

Yes. StoreEngine’s block-based, modular design works with standard WordPress themes. (eCommerce blocks require the free aBlocks plugin.)

Is StoreEngine actively developed, and can I request a feature?

Yes. StoreEngine ships new features continuously — recently adding POS, multi-location inventory, suppliers, RMA, and more. You can request features and follow progress on the public roadmap.
sections.changelog:
2.7.0 – 05/11/2026

  • Added: Multi-currency — per-product currency pricing with checkout, order confirmation and admin surfaces all respecting the product’s own currency; new extension hooks for addons.
  • Added: Tax engine — rate scope (Standard / Shipping / Compound / Reduced) and per-unit tax type on rates, exposed in the admin form, the Rates list, REST and CSV import/export.
  • Added: Checkout — store-wide Terms & Conditions checkbox (rich text) and a built-in Newsletter opt-in with Required / Optional toggles; consent defaults visible before first save.
  • Added: POS web terminal — app-style Sell, Payment, Success, Catalog, Refund, Pharmacy and Jewellery screens aligned with the desktop till.
  • Added: Customize — tabbed page navigation, breadcrumb and preview-open default, aligned with the rest of admin.
  • Added: Affiliate — major overhaul: MLM admin UI, Pro settings schema (MLM / tax / creatives / sequences), cookie-window and attribution filters (cookie_days, should_auto_approve_commission, order_attribution, me_payload), recurring commissions on renewals and installment payments, per-affiliate / per-campaign cookie-window overrides, partial-refund pro-rata, paid clawback, commission cap and master toggle, POS referral toggle, lifetime window.
  • Added: Affiliate — storeengine/affiliate/commission_created action fires after a commission is created.
  • Added: Affiliate — admin “Minimum payout” and real minimum shown on the frontend dashboard.
  • Added: Email builder — Media Library browse now reaches the editor, image uploads and video thumbnail previews fixed in Content, Hero and Video blocks.
  • Added: Membership — add-ons can keep a post locked until its drip date (new drip filter surface).
  • Added: Companion plugins — One-click install; downloads resolved only from WordPress.org, and the installer is download-only until a satellite is listed there.
  • Improved: Checkout — retry after a failed saved-card payment; clear error when a saved Stripe card can’t be charged; Instant Checkout hides Add to Cart on the single product page; cart line total honours order bump prices.
  • Improved: Subscriptions — recurring coupons carried through Paddle subscription renewals and Native Stripe subscription renewals; recurring-discount coupons visible in the cart’s Recurring Total; upcoming recurring-coupon discount shown on plan pages; recurring coupon terms snapshotted on first renewal.
  • Improved: Stripe — a saved card Stripe refuses to attach is dropped instead of being offered again; Instant Checkout attaches the card to the Stripe customer when it will be kept on file.
  • Improved: Admin — grouped admin menus and sidebar render correctly for restricted users; readable “View invoice” menu item; clean cart remove-icon focus; affiliate “Save Settings” button has a visible background; checkout consent checkboxes styled with grouped “Required” toggles and adjacent opt-ins spaced.
  • Improved: Affiliate — PRO badges replace “(Pro)” labels in settings; coupon affiliate picker spinner / spacing, clearer product hint, auto-apply cache flushed; dedicated cookie-window input, tiers hook, paid clawback.
  • Improved: POS — reuse the lowest free cart number when opening new carts; variable product base price stored as the cheapest variant.
  • Improved: Build — Strauss patch script speeds up dependency prefixing.
  • Fixed: Orders — checkout no longer saves an empty or stale order status.
  • Fixed: Customer dashboard — order count, total spent and order list show real values.
  • Fixed: Brand filter now appears on the shop page; single-product brands row spaced correctly.
  • Fixed: Returns — customer evidence upload via the returns endpoint with a clearer upload UX; “Reason” select no longer renders with a double border.
  • Fixed: Affiliate — withdrawals blocked when no usable payout method is set; amount held for pending withdrawals shown; affiliates can cancel pending withdrawal requests; payout method with saved details on resend; referral attribution and commission rate handling fixed; balance truncation fixed; no attribution when a code is used by its owner.
  • Fixed: Refund filter issues on the Payments list.
  • Fixed: Order-confirmation total now displays in the order’s currency.
  • Fixed: Multi-currency — product_currency accepted in the settings schema.
  • Fixed: Jewellery UX nested under Retail; stale addons card removed; vori readout shown.
  • Security: REST login — the same error is returned for an unknown username and a wrong password (user enumeration).
  • Security: ABSPATH guard added to block render and pattern templates, so they cannot be requested directly.
  • Security: COD availability notice escapes ampersands (hardened escaping).
  • Security: Affiliate — payout status cannot be moved between settled groups; self-attribution path removed; self-provision gated on an option; referral cookie HMAC-signed; API refuses referral code / link / coupons until the account is approved; post-editing capabilities stripped from the affiliate dashboard role; Outgoing Webhooks section removed from free settings.
  • Security: Companion plugins install path only resolves from WordPress.org (no off-WordPress.org downloads in the free plugin).
  • Security: Admin menu — restricted users no longer see grouped menu items they lack access to.
  • Security: Manual stock removal clamped to available stock (no negative inventory via bulk edit).
  • Compliance: Plugin Check — heredoc inline scripts replaced with nowdoc + placeholder; already-sanitised output annotated (no behaviour change); file-header and translator-comment cleanups.
  • Compatibility: Requires WordPress 6.8 or later.

2.6.0 – 23/10/2026

  • Added: POS — Installment plans at the till. Pick a plan at checkout to sell on instalments, with a built-in Collect Installment screen for recording follow-up payments. New offline-first SQLite data layer stores plans, schedules, instalments and collections with a versioned schedule formula.
  • Added: POS — Dues and instalment reports (Overdue, Upcoming Dues and Customer Statement) listing outstanding instalments per customer with running balances.
  • Added: POS — Refer & Earn affiliate sidebar panel. Apply to the programme, manage your API token and payout preference, see your referral link, lifetime earnings, available balance, link clicks, recent commissions, referred signups and assigned coupons — all offline-first.
  • Added: POS — Downloadable PDF documents. Offline save-as-PDF for A4 invoice, sales summary, Z-report, dues statement, refund receipt / summary, tax, stock movement, exchange slip, purity certificate, customer card and inventory stock / low-stock snapshots; a batch export zips the lot in one click.
  • Added: POS — Capabilities (Modules) settings screen with per-terminal feature toggles, licence-cache aware, so each till only shows the sections it is licensed for.
  • Added: Customize (StoreEngine → Customize) — one screen to style the whole store without code. Start from a ready-made preset, then set brand colors for light and dark mode (optionally applied to your theme’s buttons and links), the shop catalog (columns per device, image ratio, card style and which card parts show, in what order), the product page layout and sections, the cart and checkout layout, and the customer dashboard menu. Changes show in a live storefront preview before you save, with a guided tour and a “Guide me” help panel.
  • Added: Native Gutenberg blocks — 32 StoreEngine blocks for the product page (Title, Price, Media, Gallery, Add to Cart, Purchase Card, Description, Rating, Reviews, SKU, Badges, Categories, Attributes), the shop (Shop Filters, Product Filters, Search, Sort and the catalog), the cart (Cart Items, Cart Totals, Coupon Form, Mini Cart, Checkout Button), checkout (Checkout Form, Contact, Billing and Shipping Address, Payment Methods, Order Summary), orders (Order Confirmation, Order Details) and accounts (Customer Dashboard, Login Form). They follow your Customize settings and come with starter patterns.
  • Added: Block templates mode — block themes can switch the shop, product pages and checkout to editable block templates; the product card, product page, checkout and dashboard home can each be opened and edited in the block editor.
  • Added: New installs create the Cart, Checkout, Thank You and Customer Dashboard pages with native blocks instead of shortcodes.
  • Added: Bulk product import (CSV Import/Export addon) — a new Bulk Actions menu on Products with Import Bulk Products, Add Products in Bulk and Bulk Product Edit. Upload CSV or JSON (delimiter and encoding detected), map columns with suggested matches, then review everything in an editable spreadsheet grid (variations and prices nested under their product, rich-text descriptions, add/duplicate/delete rows, issues-only filter) before importing. Imports simple and variable products, prices (one-time, subscription and installment), attributes, brands, SEO fields and images, with validation for duplicate SKUs, missing parents, invalid numbers and installment totals. Includes a sample CSV and demo data.
  • Added: CAPTCHA addon (free) — protect checkout, pay for order, saved cards, login, registration, lost password, product reviews, affiliate sign-up and wp-login.php from bots with Google reCAPTCHA v2 (checkbox or invisible) or v3, Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha. Per-form switches, skip logged-in or returning customers, a “Test keys” check and live preview, encrypted secret keys, single-use tokens, per-IP rate limits (including failed coupon codes), a fail-open or fail-closed choice when the provider is down, and an activity card with failed checks. Settings live under the new Settings → Security group.
  • Added: Reports addon (free) — Revenue, Orders, Products, Customers and Refunds reports with shared date and comparison filters, CSV export, fast aggregate tables with backfill (“Rebuild data”), a REST API and permissions. Report history is kept when the addon is turned off.
  • Added: Subscription reminder emails — Upcoming Charge (auto-renewing, 3 days before payment), Renewal Reminder (manual renewals, 3 days before), Renewal Invoice (when the renewal order is created) and Renewal Overdue (1 and 3 days after an unpaid renewal). Jobs reschedule when the payment date changes and are re-checked before sending; lead days can be changed with filters.
  • Added: Store digest email — a daily, weekly or monthly performance summary for the store owner (Settings → Marketing → Store Digest): sales, orders, items sold, average order value, refunds and new customers against the previous period, a one-time vs subscription vs renewal split, top products and orders needing attention, plus sections from Subscriptions, Memberships, Inventory, Reviews, Affiliates, Funnels and Multi-currency. Sent once per period, can skip quiet periods, and supports a test send, preview, send log, Slack and JSON webhooks, staff opt-in and an optional AI summary. Also wp storeengine digest send|preview.
  • Added: Order labels — colored tags to organize orders. Manage them in Settings → Store → Labels, attach them from the order screen, the orders list or in bulk, and filter the orders list by labels (any or all). Included in the order CSV export, the REST API and a list-order-labels AI ability; StoreEngine Pro extends labels to customers and subscriptions.
  • Added: Verified purchase badge on product reviews — set automatically when the reviewer bought the product (matched by account, then billing email), re-checked when orders are paid or refunded, with manual override, a “Recalculate badges” job, a “verified buyers only” filter and wp storeengine reviews verify.
  • Added: Store replies to product reviews — reply, edit, hide or delete replies from Products → Reviews (“Reply & approve” for held reviews). Replies show under the review as “Response from {store name}”, never affect ratings, and can email the customer with the new Review Reply email.
  • Added: Membership overview on the Members page — Total, Active, Expiring soon and Expired cards, start and expiry dates, status badges and a status filter.
  • Added: Multi-location inventory — a Stock by location table on the product page with quantity and low-stock threshold per location.
  • Added: New developer hooks and capabilities: moderate_storeengine_reviews, view_storeengine_labels, manage_storeengine_labels, storeengine/review/replied, storeengine/review/verified_changed, storeengine/label/assigned, storeengine/label/removed, storeengine/store_digest/sections, storeengine/stock/adjusted, storeengine/stock/restore_qty and storeengine/membership/expiring_soon_days.
  • Improved: Admin UI pass — refreshed search inputs, products-table page-size dropdown, Settings spacing and widths, Email Notifications, Payment Methods, Tools, an Add-ons sidebar and a setup wizard notice.
  • Improved: Turned-off features now show a blurred preview with a “Turn on” button instead of disappearing (e.g. Bulk Actions, Email settings and Store Digest).
  • Improved: Membership — refunds cancel the membership instead of deleting it (so it counts toward churn), records are kept per group, role sync no longer loads every user and keeps purchase and manual grants, and the Members list is faster on large sites.
  • Improved: Variant stock — saved variant quantities are changed through Adjust stock; CSV import and variant saves keep decimal quantities.
  • Improved: CSV import — fixed legacy gallery images, cache flush and the progress indicator.
  • Fixed: Membership — relative (N-day) expiration was never enforced; one expired plan marked every plan as expired; buying again after an admin cancel kept the customer locked out.
  • Fixed: Subscriptions — the Trial Ending Soon email could be skipped for some subscriptions; a failed Stripe auto-renewal now marks the payment as failed so the subscription goes on hold; the generic Payment Failed email is no longer sent for subscriptions; read-only schedule dates on the admin Subscription screen.
  • Fixed: AI abilities did not register on WordPress 6.9 and later.
  • Fixed: Saving only part of the store digest settings switched the other options off.
  • Security: Membership — cancelled members could still open restricted pages, and a subscription-based membership could grant access to other users who had not bought it.
  • Compatibility: Requires WordPress 6.8 or later.

2.5.0 – 15/10/2026

  • Added: Shipping — new Table Rate method with a configurable measurement engine (weight, chargeable weight, volume, item count, subtotal).
  • Added: Shipping — Packages (formerly Extra Charges): scope gift wrap, packaging and handling to shipping classes, categories or products, with an optional checkout tick-box. Product-based packaging charges are also supported.
  • Added: Shipping — Free Shipping method can now hide the other methods when it is available.
  • Added: Coupons — new “Grant free shipping” option on coupons.
  • Added: Bundles — “All prices” rows on bundle prices; license snapshot captured on bundle price items, with support for a custom activation limit at the bundle-price level.
  • Added: Pricing — admin price pickers (including bundle product/price selection) now show hidden prices.
  • Added: Fonts — font download with a progress bar.
  • Improved: Shipping settings UI — two-column layout with select dropdowns, inline-edit default shipping class and package, new zones placed last, rate-table row gap and Remove button fixes, clearer field descriptions.
  • Improved: Tax — mixed-rate carts now apportion shipping tax correctly across tax classes; standardized shipping_rate handling in tax actions and the API.
  • Improved: Pricing side panel surfaces license activation info like the inline view.
  • Improved: Bundle templates — show All prices rows without a child price amount, and hide the “All prices” label on the storefront.
  • Improved: Admin UI refresh — new Attribute modal, System Logs table alignment, payment method drawer, Settings / Tools / Wholesale / Addons & Extensions pages, admin notices.
  • Improved: POS terminal — inventory sidebar, improved checkbox-switch, Locations UI refresh.
  • Fixed: Membership — a fatal and loss of access during membership renewals.
  • Fixed: Stray error_log calls left in admin code.
  • Compliance: Removed the deactivation-feedback / opt-in telemetry that posted site URL, admin email and version data to kodezen.com.
  • Compliance: Removed the site-wide “Get StoreEngine Pro” admin nag.
  • Compliance: Satellite companion plugins now install via WordPress.org’s plugins_api() instead of fetching zips from store.kodezen.com.
  • Compliance: Fixed invalid “Tested up to” header; readme now targets WordPress 6.7.
  • Compliance: Added MaxMind / GeoLite2 attribution to the readme Credits section.

2.4.0 – 01/10/2026

  • Added: Advanced filters with saved views on the Products, Orders, Customers and Payments lists — build conditions (price, stock, category, status, total, date, customer spend, order count and more), combine them with AND/OR groups, share a filtered list by URL, and save it as a named view (per user).
  • Added: Attributes manager — a two-pane screen with a searchable, paginated attribute list and the selected attribute’s terms side by side: add several terms at once (comma separated) or from presets, edit and delete in place, and drag terms and attributes to set their order everywhere.
  • Added: Logs — a details drawer with the message, file/line and stack trace, previous/next navigation and delete, plus “Copy error” (a readable report for tickets) and “Copy JSON”.
  • Added: Welcome email for customers created at checkout now includes their username, the generated password and a one-time “Set your own password” link, and is enabled by default.
  • Added: Admin top bar — search opens as a command palette (⌘K / Ctrl+K), and Screen Options / Help live in a compact “…” menu.
  • Improved: Admin design refresh — flat surfaces with borders instead of shadows (one subtle shadow only for menus, modals and other floating layers), a refreshed neutral text/border palette (saved colours still on the old defaults are updated automatically), and no web fonts loaded in admin or on the storefront.
  • Improved: Product editor — a clearer slug field (full-width URL preview, inline editor with Enter/Esc, live cleanup preview and inline errors), an empty state with a “Create attribute” link in the variants modal, and a modern Inline / Side panel switch.
  • Improved: Attribute term sorting — “Custom ordering” and “Name (numeric)” now actually apply (previously both fell back to name order).
  • Improved: Select dropdowns show full option labels (long labels wrap instead of being cut off), and the bulk-action bar is clearly outlined over the list.
  • Improved: Logs list — clearer rows (title, message, file:line), relative dates, and severity accents.
  • Improved: Deleting an attribute or term now shows what it removes — affected products, the variations deleted with it (price, SKU, stock), products left with no variations, tracked stock and past orders — and asks you to confirm; unused attributes and terms are deleted right away.
  • Improved: Variants modal — the redundant “Update product” button is gone (the header Save stays), and removing a used value asks in an in-app dialog instead of the browser’s confirm box.
  • Fixed: A storefront fatal error (“storeengine_cart(): Return value must be of type Cart, null returned”) on pages whose URL contained “wp-json/” — the request was mistaken for a REST call and the cart never loaded.
  • Fixed: The new-customer welcome email never sent on stores that had not saved their Email settings.
  • Fixed: The Logs page went blank for entries without a stack trace (e.g. PHP time-outs), which could happen right after clearing logs.
  • Fixed: Log dates were shown several hours off (they are stored in the site’s timezone, not UTC).
  • Fixed: Membership × Academy — a course available only through a membership showed as Free, with Academy’s free “Enroll Now” button next to “Purchase Membership”, so visitors could enrol without buying. It now shows as Paid with only the membership button; admins and the course instructor also get Start Course, and members keep their own access.
  • Fixed: Deleting an attribute left it in products’ saved attribute order, and deleting a term kept offering its variations on the storefront until the product cache cleared.
  • Security: The product attribute AJAX actions had no capability check, so any logged-in user could delete attributes and the variations built on them. They now require an administrator (store staff keep access through Pro’s Staff & Permissions).

2.3.0 – 03/09/2026

  • Added: Donations & Name Your Price addon (free) — donation/NYP pricing mode on any product with a proper +/- stepper amount field, configurable below-minimum message, optional fee recovery, a free Donations admin page and Settings tab, a donor account-dashboard tab, and a fundraiser payee type in the unified payouts ledger.
  • Added: Decimal quantities & Unit of Measure (core) — products can be sold by weight, volume or length (not just whole units) via a new “Sold by” section on the product editor (unit, smallest increment, and the purchase-unit pack factor used when receiving stock, e.g. a carton of 20 strips of 10 tablets); the Pricing panel now captions the price’s own unit (e.g. “Price is per 1 kg”) separately from the purchase conversion.
  • Added: Inventory — Batches & expiry admin page with a per-product “track in batches” toggle; a Serials page for serial/IMEI tracking; a Stocktake page for physical counts.
  • Added: POS terminal — fractional-quantity cart lines with a numeric keypad for weighed/measured items; quote redemption at the till (replaces the cart with the quote’s frozen prices); a pharmacy “Before you charge” sign-off panel (ID check, prescription-per-line, controlled-substance register) with a prescription picker; trade/customer-group pricing with a struck-through was-price, case-quantity rounding on scan/grid/keypad, and an on-account tender panel showing available credit.
  • Added: Retail (Grocery & Pharmacy) and Wholesale (B2B) addon teaser cards on the Add-ons screen (Pro).
  • Added: Logs — a “Clear logs” action (All / older-than-N-days), a wp storeengine logs cleanup|clear WP-CLI command, a manual “Clean up now” button, and full logger-level coverage (Info/Critical/Emergency/Alert/Debug added to filtering and auto-cleanup).
  • Added: Settings → Pages tab so addons can contribute their own store pages; storeengine/frontend/show_floating_cart filter.
  • Added: Donations — name-your-price / donation mode can now be enabled on subscription prices, and Settings → Donations gains an above-maximum message to sit alongside the existing below-minimum one.
  • Improved: Coupons admin — the list resolves category/product restriction ids to readable names instead of raw ids (no per-row lookups), plus sortable columns and a fixed product/customer search.
  • Improved: Product editor — a shared split Save button (also used on the access-group editor); the pricing-mode selector moved above the price fields; donation/name-your-price field treatment reused for Add/Edit Price; price rows show their own loading state and roll back correctly if a delete fails.
  • Improved: Floating cart badge caps at “99+”; distributable zip shrunk by excluding dev-only Composer packages, PR test screenshots and working notes from the dist build.
  • Improved: Admin and storefront UI pass across multi-vendor, geolocation, reviews, membership, affiliate success messaging, downloadable files, FAQ groups, the create-shipment modal, the licenses table, the setup-wizard copy and the empty “no products” state.
  • Fixed: Decimal quantities — order/cart building, the stock manager and coupon paths no longer truncate fractional quantities to 0 through stale int type hints; the DB version is bumped so the migration actually runs on existing 2.2.0 installs; quantity columns widened to DECIMAL(15,3) after an initial DECIMAL(12,3) pass silently under-sized large values.
  • Fixed: Coupons — discounting silently skipped rows after the first matching product; a code shared by several per-product coupon posts could resolve to the wrong post (now scored against the live cart); product/price id comparisons coerced to int so migrated numeric-string ids match; coupon product/customer search and restricted-product title rendering.
  • Fixed: Bundles — adding a product to a bundle after purchase could leave buyers with a license key and no download, from a paid-status filter that missed processing/active orders, a strict-mode GROUP BY that dropped every licensed download, a join that hid keys with no release yet, and pagination that only counted file-permission rows.
  • Fixed: Licenses list route now honors filters (product, expiry, activation state, reseller type); a WHERE built only from IS NULL/IS NOT NULL conditions no longer misfires $wpdb->prepare().
  • Fixed: Dashboard endpoints 404ing after an addon toggle or plugin restore — rewrite rules are rebuilt when the registered endpoints change.
  • Fixed: Password-reset email links redirected to the login screen instead of the reset form; recently-viewed products rendered after the footer on block (FSE) themes.
  • Fixed: PHP 8 fatals from method_exists() on a bool/null return, hardened across the codebase; a related TypeError in subscription get_related_orders_date(); Stripe now fails safe with an admin notice instead of fataling repeatedly when the bundled SDK isn’t loadable.
  • Fixed: Log-cleanup retention compared against UTC instead of the site timezone.
  • Fixed: Product gallery video embeds; auto barcode/SKU generation; login, register and forgot-password UI; checkout email validation; WooCommerce checkout-draft orders wrongly included in migration; email-template width; PHPCS ruleset failing to run under WPCS 3.x.
  • Fixed: GA4 and Meta pixel purchase tracking silently losing conversions when the buyer landed anywhere other than the default thank-you page.
  • Fixed: Order totals could round inconsistently between the places that display them, so the same order showed two different figures.
  • Fixed: Donation orders placed against a subscription were counted twice in donation totals.
  • Fixed: Coupon search missed matches when searching by coupon code; the add-to-cart AJAX handler submitted disabled fields; EU-compliance select text rendered incorrectly; a redundant Roles child menu item was removed.
  • Security: The Restrict Content Pro CSV export action was reachable without an administrator check and could be invoked by unauthenticated visitors; it now requires manage_options and validates the requested export type against a fixed list. Sites with the CSV addon enabled should update.
  • Security: The logs REST collection endpoint was readable without a capability check — it now requires manage_options, matching every other route on that controller.
  • Security: Updated the bundled FPDI PDF library to 2.6.8, picking up the fix for CVE-2026-45802 (denial of service through memory exhaustion while parsing a crafted PDF).
  • Security: Hardened object deserialization and made the table prefix explicit in the deprecated subscription model; escaped an admin-configured message before it reached an exception.
  • Changed: The donation addon versions its own DB schema the way core does; the mini-cart drawer no longer opens automatically by default.

2.2.0 – 30/07/2026

  • Added: Product Quick View — open any catalog product in a modal straight from the shop/archive, with configurable trigger position and animation, an optional whole-card trigger, full keyboard/accessibility support, and working variant price and add-to-cart.
  • Added: Wishlist (core) — a heart control on product cards and single-product pages lets shoppers save products; the card heart reveals on hover.
  • Added: Product Compare — select multiple products and compare their details side by side.
  • Added: Recently Viewed products — surface the products a shopper has recently browsed.
  • Added: Size Chart library — reusable size guides assigned by brand or category and shown as a size guide on the product page.
  • Added: Reviews & FAQ — a buyer review form with photo/video review media and a dashboard entry, an admin Reviews management page (with REST), plus per-product and global FAQ libraries.
  • Added: Custom product gallery — carousel, stacked and grid layouts with lightbox and zoom, product-editor gallery swatches, and a unified image/video gallery.
  • Added: Shop-card variant switcher — Shopify-style variant swatches on archive/shop cards to switch the pictured and priced variant without opening the product.
  • Added: Sticky add-to-cart bar and cart-drawer auto-open — a persistent add-to-cart bar (mobile and desktop) and an option to open the cart drawer automatically after adding.
  • Added: Embeddable product shortcode — drop a single product anywhere via shortcode.
  • Added: Couriers — the shipment/courier framework now ships in free core (previously Pro): a Shipments model, provider registry, auto-push on paid orders, and order-status sync back to the order. Concrete carriers ship in the free StoreEngine Connectors companion plugin.
  • Added: Courier OAuth authentication — a reusable OAuth2 engine supporting one-click “Connect” (3-legged authorization code with automatic token refresh) and server-to-server client-credentials, with Connect/Disconnect from Settings → Couriers.
  • Added: Dropshipping addon — auto-route paid orders to suppliers for direct fulfilment, create/email purchase orders, capture supplier tracking, and roll fulfilment status back onto the order.
  • Added: Suppliers & Purchase Orders addon — track suppliers and raise POs, with a magic-link supplier portal, PO approvals, and low-stock auto-reorder.
  • Added: Companion-plugin ecosystem — the License SDK is now loaded by core so the free StoreEngine Payments / Connectors plugins receive automatic updates even without Pro; install-only teasers on the Payment method and Couriers settings surface them with one-click install & activate.
  • Added: Incoming webhooks receiver.
  • Added: Single-product analytics.
  • Added: Scheduled backups.
  • Added: Shortcode → block bridge — StoreEngine shortcodes are available as native blocks.
  • Added: First-run setup wizard redesign — product-type-aware capability selection, a Payments step, and a post-setup “connect your payment method” notice.
  • Added: A Refund action in the order editor top bar; Copy Link in the product price menu (generates a checkout link without a reload); and a Tools-page tab API so addons can contribute their own tabs.
  • Added: A “Couriers” tab on the Add-ons screen linking to courier settings.
  • Improved: Major admin UI refresh onto a shared Tailwind design kit — Settings, the Products editor, the Setup wizard, and standard pages rebuilt on one system (themed checkboxes/switches/selects, consistent cards, borders and spacing, redesigned notice cards with a grouping bell).
  • Improved: Admin navigation reorganized — collapsible parent groups in the sidebar, raw-route child menus, Fraud Shield promoted to a top-level menu, and centralized submenu ordering.
  • Improved: Dashboard — a shared page header across core and vendor pages, and affiliate referral + balance merged into one card.
  • Improved: Checkout, cart and instant-checkout polish — card backgrounds, refined order-bump cards, and installment “Future Payments” summaries.
  • Improved: Add-ons — payment-gateway and courier cards moved off the main list; the “requires add-ons” notice is a clean footer chip and long descriptions are clamped so cards align evenly.
  • Improved: Migrated admin selects to the shared Tailwind Select component, resolving country/state selection and various select sizing/width/hover issues.
  • Improved: Affiliate & commission workflow, including always-on self-referral protection with an optional “Allow Self-Referral” toggle.
  • Fixed: Product-gallery video embeds hardened (defense-in-depth), plus assorted product-layout, scroll and storefront UI fixes.
  • Fixed: Coupons on subscription orders (and the coupon code now appears in the email); optional compare-at price no longer blocks re-saving; tax invoice issues; funnel issues; missing shortcode pages.
  • Fixed: Courier settings toggles rendered with a stuck switch thumb; buttons default to type=”button” to prevent accidental form submits; and a broad admin UI/spacing/border audit across tables, modals, notices and list-table footers.
  • Changed: Couriers use the shared addon schema-version system; removed unused table-drop code (StoreEngine never drops tables) and a bundled frontend font.

2.1.1 – 13/07/2026

  • Added: Multi-vendor admin-initiated custom vendor payouts — an “Add Payout” modal to pay a vendor any amount up to their available balance (in instalments), with new admin-only pay/vendor-balance routes and an overdraw guard.
  • Added: Affiliate registration form fields (first/last name, website URL, promotional methods, terms agreement) and a Registration section in Affiliate settings.
  • Improved: Affiliate addon — reworked affiliates table/settings plus numerous registration and payout correctness fixes.
  • Fixed: Stripe Elements failing to load on checkout — the confirm/submit path now waits for the card iframe’s real ready event, and the checkout page sends no-store so Chromium back/forward-cache …

short_description: Sell digital & physical products with StoreEngine—a lightweight eCommerce solution with memberships, subscriptions, affiliates, coupons & licensing.
description:
StoreEngine — The Complete WordPress eCommerce Plugin to Build, Sell, and Run Your Entire Store

StoreEngine is a complete WordPress ecommerce plugin and store management platform — a fast, modern, lightweight market leader alternative that lets you sell digital products, physical products, subscriptions, memberships, courses, services, and licenses from a single Gutenberg-native core.

But StoreEngine is no longer just an online store plugin. It now runs your entire commerce operation: a built-in POS terminal, inventory and multi-location stock control, suppliers and purchase orders, cost and profit tracking, returns (RMA), courier management, and a full multi-vendor marketplace — all without stacking 5+ premium plugins or paying for add-ons.

Whether you sell online, in person, or both, StoreEngine gives you everything to start, manage, and scale your store inside WordPress — securely, smoothly, and without slowing your site down.

Check our overview video of StoreEngine 👇

StoreEngine | Docs | Video Tutorials | Community | Public Roadmap

🎯 Built for store owners who want everything in one place

  • Agencies & freelancers — ship a complete store for any client without stacking plugins
  • Digital creators — sell ebooks, software, templates, and assets with secure file delivery and license keys
  • Physical & retail sellers — manage inventory, POS, shipping, suppliers, and returns from one dashboard
  • Subscription & membership businesses — recurring billing, trials, upgrades, and gated access, natively
  • Course creators — sell online courses through native Academy LMS integration
  • Service providers — sell packages, appointments, and one-time services with flexible checkout
  • Marketplace builders — launch a multi-vendor store with vendor dashboards and commissions

🛒 Sell Anything — Digital, Physical, Subscriptions & More

StoreEngine handles every product type from one ecommerce dashboard — no separate plugins, no extra add-on costs.

  • Sell digital products — secure, signed download URLs with instant delivery for software, ebooks, music, and design assets
  • Physical product selling — SKU tracking, variants (size, color, material), and stock status built in
  • Subscription products — flexible billing cycles with trials, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations
  • Memberships & access control — gate content, courses, and communities with one-time or recurring access
  • Sell online courses — native Academy LMS integration for course checkout, enrollments, and bundles
  • License management — automate license creation, activation, renewals, and usage tracking
  • Product bundles — group products, courses, or memberships into a single high-value offer
  • Installment plans — let customers pay high-ticket items in scheduled payments to reduce hesitation
  • Catalog mode — display products without checkout, perfect for wholesalers and previews

🏬 Run Your Whole Store — POS, Inventory & Operations

This is where StoreEngine goes beyond a typical WordPress ecommerce plugin into a full retail and store management system.

  • POS terminal — fast in-person checkout with online/offline inventory sync; sell in-store and online from one system
  • Inventory management — stock tracking, quantity adjustments, low-stock alerts, and movement monitoring
  • Multi-location inventory — manage stock across warehouses and stores with transfers and availability tracking
  • Suppliers & purchase orders — create POs, track incoming stock, and streamline restocking
  • Cost & profit tracking — monitor product costs, margins, and store profitability for smarter pricing
  • Return / RMA system — structured returns, refund requests, and approval workflows
  • Couriers management — manage delivery couriers, fulfillment, and order tracking centrally
  • Shipping module — multiple zones, flat-rate pricing, and real-time carrier integrations
  • SKU & barcode generator — auto-generate SKUs and barcode labels with logo and store-name toggles

💳 Payments & Checkout That Convert

  • Stripe & PayPal out of the box — PCI-DSS compliant card payments, refunds, and subscription billing
  • Razorpay — accept UPI, net banking, wallets, and cards across India
  • Native Stripe subscriptions — webhook-driven renewals with “Pay Next Renewal Now” support
  • Subscriptions + one-time products in the same cart — single checkout, no separate orders
  • Installment & free (zero-total) checkout — flexible payment flows and frictionless giveaways
  • Order pay — recover failed or pending orders without creating a new one
  • Direct checkout URLs — pre-applied products and coupons for funnels and campaigns
  • Multi-currency support — let customers browse and pay in their preferred currency
  • StoreEngine invoice — auto-generate professional invoices customers can download instantly

📈 Built-in Growth & Marketing Tools

Most plugins charge extra for the features that actually grow revenue. StoreEngine includes them natively.

  • Upsell & cross-sell — boost average order value with related offers and post-purchase add-ons
  • Built-in affiliate system — track referrals, manage commissions, and turn customers into promoters
  • Coupons & discounts — flat or percentage offers with expiry dates and usage limits
  • Advanced analytics dashboard — revenue trends, product performance, and conversion data in one place

🤝 Launch a Multi-Vendor Marketplace

Turn your store into a multi-vendor marketplace where vendors register, manage their own products, and sell from a dedicated dashboard — with commission tracking, approvals, and centralized admin control.

🌍 Compliance, SEO & AI — Future-Ready by Default

  • EU VAT & EU compliance — VAT validation, sequential invoice numbers, and a consent log
  • GDPR & privacy compliance — data export, erasure requests, and order anonymization via the WordPress Privacy API
  • Tax management — per-product, per-region tax rules with inclusive or exclusive pricing
  • Built-in SEO addon — dual-mode engine that integrates with Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress, or works standalone, with REST support for headless storefronts
  • AI content generation — native WordPress AI abilities for product copy and SEO meta; runs on your own hosting with no third-party API keys required (opt-in AI add-ons for other features are listed under External services)
  • Brand management — organize and display products by brand for multi-manufacturer stores

🛠️ Developer-Friendly & Admin-First

  • Webhooks — push order, customer, and subscription events to CRMs and automation tools
  • WP-CLI support — manage your store from the command line, including demo-content seeders
  • Admin global search & command palette — jump to any setting instantly with Cmd/Ctrl+K
  • Migration tool — import products, customers, and orders from any eCommerce without breaking your layout
  • CSV import / export — bulk-manage products, customers, and orders
  • Activity & error logger — debug payments and monitor store operations
  • GeoIP & location-based commerce — smarter shipping, currency, and checkout by location
  • Email notifications — branded, customizable transactional emails with no code
  • Setup wizard — configure payments and core settings in minutes

Note: StoreEngine’s eCommerce blocks require the free aBlocks plugin — the modern Gutenberg website builder.

💥 Why StoreEngine Instead of Stacking Plugins

Most WordPress ecommerce setups need five or more plugins — one for subscriptions, one for memberships, one for invoicing, another for POS or inventory — each adding cost, bloat, and conflicts.

StoreEngine is built from the ground up to solve that. Checkout, cart, coupons, product filtering, and login are all native Gutenberg blocks, so you control your entire store flow without code. Business-critical features like subscriptions, memberships, webhooks, invoicing, affiliates, and POS activate with a single click. The result is a lighter, faster, more secure, and future-ready way to run commerce on WordPress.

Get Started With StoreEngine

From your first digital download to a multi-location retail operation, StoreEngine grows with you — one fast plugin instead of a dozen. Install StoreEngine today, run your setup wizard, and start selling in minutes.

Join the thriving StoreEngine community of entrepreneurs, creators, and developers building scalable, secure online stores worldwide.

Stay connected for the latest updates and insights:

👉 Our Official Facebook Page

👉 Follow us on Twitter / X
👉 Connect on LinkedIn
👉 Our Official Support
👉 Video Tutorials

External services

StoreEngine can connect to a number of third-party services. Everything in this list is optional, off by default, and only activates when you turn on the corresponding addon or paste in your own URL / credentials. No store data leaves your site until you do.

  • Payment providers — Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, Razorpay, Mollie, Paystack, Square. Enabled per gateway on Settings → Payment methods. Order, customer and payment details are sent to the gateway you choose. See each provider’s privacy policy and terms of service for details.
  • Shipping carriers / couriers — DHL, UPS, FedEx and the regional couriers you enable on Settings → Shipping. Order address and parcel details are sent only to the carriers you turn on.
  • IP geolocation — only when Settings → “Default customer location” is set to a geolocation option. If no local MaxMind database is available, the visitor’s IP address is sent to one of these lookup services to find their country: ipinfo.io (privacy), freeipapi.com (privacy), ipapi.co (privacy), ipwhois.app (privacy). When the site runs on a local or private network, the store’s own public IP is first looked up through ipify, ipecho.net, ident.me or tnedi.me; only the request itself is sent.
  • MaxMind GeoLite2 — when you enter a MaxMind license key for geolocation, the key is validated with MaxMind and the GeoLite2 country database is downloaded from download.maxmind.com and refreshed periodically. Only the license key is sent. Terms, privacy policy.
  • EU VAT number validation — when the EU VAT addon is enabled and a customer enters a VAT number at checkout, the VAT number and its country code are sent to the European Commission’s VIES service (privacy) or, for UK numbers, to HMRC’s VAT check API (privacy).
  • Currency exchange rates — when the Multi-Currency addon is set to update rates automatically, the store’s base currency (and your API key, where the provider needs one) is sent to the provider you pick: Frankfurter (no key), Open Exchange Rates (terms, privacy), ExchangeRate-API (terms) or CurrencyBeacon (terms).
  • CAPTCHA — when the CAPTCHA addon is enabled for a form, the provider’s script is loaded on that form, and the visitor’s CAPTCHA response token and IP address are sent to the provider to verify it: Google reCAPTCHA (terms, privacy), Cloudflare Turnstile (terms, privacy) or hCaptcha (terms, privacy).
  • Invoice PDF fonts — when an admin clicks “Download fonts” in the Invoice addon settings, a font archive (TTF files only, no code) is downloaded from kodezen.com so PDFs can render non-Latin scripts. No site data is sent. Terms, privacy policy.
  • Store digest webhook / Slack — if you paste an https webhook URL or Slack incoming-webhook URL into Settings → Marketing → Store Digest, the digest payload (KPIs, top products, orders needing attention) is POSTed to that URL on each scheduled send. Leave the fields empty and nothing is sent.
  • Store digest AI summary (opt-in) — when “AI insights” is enabled on Settings → Marketing → Store Digest, a short JSON blob of the period’s KPIs, top three products and attention counts is sent to the AI endpoint configured by the AI addon so it can write one summary paragraph. Off by default; turning it off removes the request entirely.
  • Native “AI content generation” uses the built-in WordPress AI abilities on your own hosting; it does not require third-party API keys and does not send data to Kodezen.
  • Update server — StoreEngine Pro and the paid addons check for updates against Kodezen’s update server using the license key you entered. Only the license key, site URL and the plugin / addon versions are sent. The free StoreEngine plugin updates through WordPress.org.

Please consult each service’s privacy policy and terms of service before enabling it. StoreEngine itself does not phone home from the free wordpress.org build without your explicit action.

Credits

StoreEngine’s optional geolocation feature uses GeoLite2 data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com.

storeengine/order-confirmation.name: storeengine/order-confirmation

storeengine/product-attributes.name: storeengine/product-attributes

storeengine/product-rating.name: storeengine/product-rating
